status: adaptive development experiment, specified after observing r1 failure
question: Does training an independent body attention branch help more than fitting the final heads on a frozen old body representation?
data: exact unchanged datasets/vtuber-v4-intent-v1; same split and draft annotations
encoder: frozen Qwen3.5-4B, cache full tokens, no backbone finetuning
production_isolation: independent copied body branch; no old weights/configuration/default changes or new runtime promotion
objective: acceptable-set NLL + 0.25 preferred CE + 4 conditional interval strength squared loss + 1 necessity CE
selection: fixed last step and all three seeds; no best checkpoint or seed selection
calibration: exact same temperatures, threshold grid and objective as r1, on calibration only
evaluate: same 60 development clauses/18 family clusters, report raw proposals and calibrated proposals, all histories as secondary
limitations: Development set already inspected in r1; this is iterative method development, not an independent final generalization claim. No human naturalness or risk bound claim.
